safe_use_note: This report is a Dutch-only readiness audit for product-side evidence. It is not an inspection judgement, compliance claim, approval, certificate, OP0 completion claim, school-obligation claim, PTA-validity claim, summative-validity claim, classroom-implementation proof, or school-SKA claim.

audit_dimensions.finding: The lesson checkout has 21 Book 1 quality-ref files across chapters 1.1 through 1.5, while the target-exercise registry has 12 count-bearing Module 1 records only for chapters 1.1 through 1.3.
audit_dimensions.gap: Chapters 1.4 and 1.5 have generated/review evidence but no matching target-registry records in the inspected registry.

audit_dimensions.finding: All nine theory records for Module 1 are still marked migrated_from_v4_needs_v5_review; the three mixed-practice records are placeholders needing review.
audit_dimensions.gap: No inspected Book 1 target record has final v5-reviewed status.

audit_dimensions.finding: Exam-code links exist for 1.2.2, 1.2.3, 1.3.1, 1.3.2, and 1.3.3, and the cited codes map to official-question records. Chapter 1.1 has no exam-code links in the target registry.
Only the exact local 1.1.2 exit-ticket candidate has reviewed target-equivalent proof, and that proof remains local and flagged.
audit_dimensions.gap: 1.1.1, 1.1.3, all 1.2 records, and all 1.3 records lack reviewed target-equivalent proof.

audit_dimensions.finding: Chapter 1.1 first-three paragraphs have Part A and companion review evidence; chapters 1.2 through 1.5 have paragraph review files but not the same companion-review depth, and 1.5 carries blocked quality-ref records.
audit_dimensions.gap: Review schemas vary, PASS WITH FLAGS remains common, and some quality-ref status is stale or blocked.

audit_dimensions.finding: Generated Book 1 lesson folders and quality-ref files exist across 1.1 through 1.5.
audit_dimensions.gap: Artifact presence is not reviewed quality, target finality, exam alignment, or target-equivalent proof.

audit_dimensions.finding: Accessibility-adjacent evidence exists through companion reviews, check-surface packets, asset/alt-text flags, mobile/dark evidence references, and quality-ref records for the accepted first-three paragraph scope.
evidence: ../4veco-lessen/Boek 1 - Grondslagen, vraag en aanbod/1.1 Hoofdstuk Economisch denken en rekenen/
audit_dimensions.gap: There is no unified full accessibility audit across Book 1 or across candidate expansion chapters.

audit_dimensions.finding: Product-side support evidence exists in review notes, route/check surfaces, practice progression, and differentiated exercise language, but it remains advisory product evidence.
audit_dimensions.gap: No product evidence proves school monitoring, interventions, accommodations, care plans, or support decisions.

audit_dimensions.finding: School-owned evidence is still needed for curriculum planning, classroom implementation, support decisions, PTA/grading/summative policy, governance, and inspection dialogue.
audit_dimensions.gap: 4veco product-side evidence cannot replace school-owned evidence.

audit_dimensions.finding: Main risks are overclaiming OP0/basic-skills, treating migrated target exercises as final, treating generated artifacts as reviewed quality, treating local 1.1.2 proof as product-wide target-equivalence, treating accessibility screenshots as full proof, or treating product QA as school SKA evidence.
audit_dimensions.gap: Future reports must continue carrying forbidden-inference wording per category.

school_owned_evidence_still_needed: Full school curriculum plan, scheduling, and implementation choices.
Classroom enactment, teacher adaptation, and interaction evidence.
School-wide Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, and citizenship basic-skills policy and practice.
Student monitoring, interventions, accommodations, care plans, and support decisions.
PTA, grading, summative assessment policy, transition decisions, and formal assessment validity evidence.
School governance, self-evaluation, improvement planning, board accountability, and inspection-dialogue evidence.
unsafe_claim_risks: Do not infer final-reviewed curriculum evidence from migrated target records.
Do not infer target-equivalent closure from target-exercise or answer-model presence.
Do not generalize the exact 1.1.2 local target-equivalent proof to other paragraphs.
Do not treat generated artifact presence as reviewed lesson quality.
Do not treat review screenshots or route-local checks as full accessibility proof.
Do not treat product route/check surfaces as school monitoring or support evidence.
Do not treat product QA records as school SKA evidence.
Do not use proeftoets/test-prep evidence to make PTA, summative-validity, grading, or school-obligation claims.

validation_notes.next_required_action: Run INSPECT-9 as a gap-closure planning sprint before any additional Dutch evidence-pack generation.
